pages.text: $(italic)Loose paper, folded twice, wedged behind a stone in the cellar. Josie's hand, faster than usual.$()$(br2)Feb 1 -- lit. 31 out. Greenhouse 61.$(br)Feb 2 -- held. Bread.$(br)Feb 3 -- held.$(br)Feb 4 -- held. Marnie brought soup up, said the lane looked like a fair.
